turns.text: My 3-month-old wakes every hour when she sleeps on her back and I'm exhausted. What can I do to improve her sleep while keeping her on her back?
Why do babies at this age wake so often? Is it hunger, comfort, or just how their sleep works?
How does swaddling work safely at three months, and when should I stop?
If I asked a health visitor about this, what would they check first?
What do sleep consultants who follow safe-sleep rules usually suggest for frequent waking at this age?
A friend says white noise transformed her baby's sleep. Is there a right way to use it?
Another parent said room temperature was the thing that made the difference for them. What's the right range, and how do I check?
I'm a single parent, back at work, and I'm so tired I nearly crashed the car. What's the one change most likely to help this week?
How do I settle her when she wakes without picking her up every time? I don't want to teach her to need me every hour.
Could you give me a bedtime routine and a plan for the night wakings — swaddle, noise, temperature, how to respond — for the next two weeks?
